title: installer: meet its unmet requirement marks
prior_work: Meet the unmet requirement marks in build/requirements/installer.md, each with a test under newgroup/test/ that fails with the change reverted. The installer Worker (newgroup) is a live site: its code and local tests are yours, deploying it never is. Its tests also include newgroup's embed build (npm run embed) before node --test.
